name: Washington
basePeriod: The first four of the last five completed calendar quarters before your claim. Washington uses the last four completed quarters only if those do not qualify.
notModeled: Claims opened before July 5, 2026 use $366 to $1,152 a week.
The alternate base year: enter whichever four quarters ESD will use.

citation.sourceDocument: RCW 50.04.030, 50.20.120; ESD news release on 2026 benefit amounts (June 2026)
citation.sourceNote: RCW 50.20.120: the weekly amount is "three and eighty-five one-hundredths percent of the average quarterly wages" in the two highest quarters, rounded down, and the total "the lesser of twenty-six times the weekly benefit amount ... or one-third of the individual's base year wages." RCW 50.04.030: at least "six hundred eighty hours" in the base year. ESD: the minimum "will increase by $17 to $383, for new claims opened on or after July 5, 2026. The maximum ... will increase by $56 to $1,208", and "No one can receive a weekly benefit amount that exceeds their average weekly wage" (a quarter's wages over 13). Washington pays no dependent allowance. Read 2026-10-19.
